_comment: Which books exist and how they are built from the pools in tools/library/. See tools/build_books.mjs. Every puzzle goes in at most one book. Books are made in this order: Start here, then each section in turn.

start.title: Start here
start.blurb: A guided path on 6×6 boards: one new shape at a time, easy first, ending with a taste of two shapes.

sections.blurb: The original puzzle: cut the board into L tetrominoes. Mixed board sizes.
Every tile is the same shape (not the L): a mix of shapes and board sizes in each book.
Each tile is either of two shapes: a mix of pairs and board sizes in each book.
